The camp is for all female bikers who want to learn something new, stop being afraid on the bike and gain confidence off-road. We'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles and small drops. All in a one-day course for women, girls and young ladies. From this year we're e-bike friendly – if your e-bike is suitable for off-road riding, you can sign up with it too.

LOCATION:

This year we have more training locations available. The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something on the pump track, in the skills centre and on the benches. On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling.

In nearby Říčany we helped build a small trail, including several jumps (benches).

There are also plenty of forest spots nearby for practising technique on roots or trails. The braver ones can also try drops. We won't force anyone into anything, but we'll provide the options, motivation and instruction on how to do it.

You can also get to the park where we start by train, from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Women and girls aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also women). Groups will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders, but more advanced riders will find something here too – whether fine-tuning position and braking technique, or more demanding features later on.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. Availability is shown as text, with details on request. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
